cash_tip: Good news if you are low on pesos: GOAT Beach Club, Papá Omar and JahGyro Gyros all take cards this week, so you can save your cash for tacos, taxis and the market. When you do hit an ATM, use a bank one like Kapital rather than a standalone machine, choose decline conversion so you are charged in pesos, and take out a larger amount once to keep the fees down.
